stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

## Verified transformation
Preserve the grid and every outlined rectangle's border/background. Fill the blank enclosed interior of each hollow rectangular frame with a solid color. The fill is not determined by border color alone: demo 2 has border color 5 frames with different fills. Preserve dimensions and positions.

## Verified examples
- Demo 1 (17x28, background 3): color-6 frame with 2x2 interior was filled with 2.

  - color-6 frame, 2x2 interior -> 2.

  - color-5 frame, 3x4 interior -> 2.

The frame fill appears to depend on the enclosed rectangle's properties (at least not border color alone), but these examples do not establish the full rule. In a recurring instance, measure each interior carefully and use demonstrations to infer the mapping; do not fill the space between frames or change borders. Keep the original grid dimensions. Check every row width and ensure only enclosed interior cells were changed; a prior speculative submission overfilled the large frame and was incorrect. The later output matching the examples above was marked correct.
